FedAVOT Core Metrics

Five aggregation rules × two datasets × two availability regimes, recomputed from the completed 2026-08-10 sweep (no retraining). "Final model" loss = tail-500 (mean over rounds 3500–3999), computed per seed, then mean ± std over 5 seeds. Source data: results/2026-08-10_main_sweep/; script & CSVs: results/2026-08-15_herlock_core_metrics/.

Tuned CVaR configs used everywhere below

Per-cell min-max winners on worst-group tail-500 (γ=1 rows excluded — they are bit-identical to the plain baselines). IMDb-Wiki infeasible uses the best genuine CVaR cell (α<1, γ<1); no CVaR config beats baseline there, so those two are ≈ their own baselines by construction.

cellFedAVOT+CVaRFedCVaR

Bonus — Adult per-client loss over training (5-seed mean)

All-100-client losses are logged every round in the sweep CSVs, so these needed no new runs. FedAVOT+CVaR at its tuned config vs plain FedAVOT, clients grouped by race (White 0–84, Black 85–94, Asian-Pac-Islander 95–97, Amer-Indian-Eskimo 98, Other 99); shared color scale, clipped at the joint 99.5th percentile.
